lines.t: The kingdom of heaven is like a landowner Who had a large field full of sheep
Sheep of every kind and many young lambs
Yet in his field he noticed that many sheep had become ill
Due to disease and others had wandered off
Behold, many wolves were there also
Stealing his sheep and killing his lambs
Therefore he sent his chief shepherd
To call to his sheep and to every lamb
Until all who knew the sound
Of His voice had gathered to Him
Setting them in safety apart from all that offends
The landowner came and fought from his house
And burned the field with fire
Therefore, let those who have ears to hear, hear
and shall also come and finish his work.
Lo, he has entered the field
Yet the sheep do not depart
until the shepherd calls them through the gate.
